name: main
description: This combines microservices to run concurrently

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:auth" "npm run dev:inventory" "npm run dev:forecast" "npm run dev:causal" "npm run dev:chat" "npm run dev:notification" "npm run dev:pos" "npm run dev:vision" "npm run dev:n8n" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.install: npm --prefix cortex-backend/auth-service install && npm --prefix cortex-backend/inventory-service install && npm --prefix cortex-backend/forecasting-service install && npm --prefix cortex-backend/causal-service install && npm --prefix cortex-backend/chat-service install && npm --prefix cortex-backend/notification-service install && npm --prefix cortex-backend/pos-service install && npm --prefix cortex-backend/vision-service install && npm --prefix cortex-backend/n8n install && npm --prefix cortex-web install
